mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy that lowers equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns align with FEDFUNDS trend direction in less than 60% of observations over any 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or mean return difference from baseline is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate and unemployment rate above thresholds indicate monetary tightening coinciding with labor market stress, amplifying recession risks and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of interaction-triggered instances, or interaction term coefficient is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% yoy), the Federal Reserve maintains restrictive policy that increases real rates and depresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of high-inflation periods, or average return in regime is not significantly lower than low-inflation average (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts trend (HOUST) over the past 3 months indicates strong consumer demand that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns align with HOUST trend direction in less than 55% of observations over any 2-year rolling window, or Rank IC falls below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 102.0 for two consecutive months, it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profits and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or mean return difference from baseline is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and industrial production above thresholds indicate broad economic slowdown that suppresses revenue growth, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of interaction-triggered instances, or interaction term coefficient is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 4.5%), labor market weakness suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of high-unemployment periods, or average return in regime is not significantly lower than low-unemployment average (p > 0.05).
